test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Stippulate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of '**Stippulate**' according to the English dictionary is '**Stipulate**'.
 
• The word '**Stipulate**' means '**to say exactly and officially what must be done**'.(शर्त लगाना)
 
• Hence, the **most appropriate** answer is 'Stippulate'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of other options.
 
 
• **Manipulate**- to influence somebody so that he/she does or thinks what you want.(चालाकी से काम निकालना)
 
• **Postulate**- to suggest or accept that something is true so that it can be used as the basis for a theory.(स्वयं सिद्ध मान लेना)
 
• **Calculate**- to find something out by using mathematics.(गणना)
